mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE dept_tree AS ( SELECT id, parentId FROM department WHERE id = #{departmentId} AND delflag = 0 UNION ALL SELECT d.id, d.parentId FROM department d INNER JOIN dept_tree dt ON d.parentId = dt.id WHERE d.delflag = 0 ) SELECT id FROM dept_tree

WITH RECURSIVE dept_path AS ( SELECT id, parentId, name, CAST(name AS CHAR(1000)) as path FROM department WHERE id = #{departmentId} AND delflag = 0
UNION ALL
SELECT d.id, d.parentId, d.name, CONCAT(d.name, ' > ', dp.path) as path FROM department d INNER JOIN dept_path dp ON d.id = dp.parentId WHERE d.delflag = 0 ) SELECT path FROM dept_path WHERE parentId = 0 OR parentId IS NULL LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM department WHERE parentId = #{parentId} AND delflag = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE department SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{departmentId} AND delflag = 0
